children: Injective's IIP-709 chain upgrade is now live on the network. The upgrade introduces lower, predictable gas fees for activity on Injective.

The fixed fees cover real-world asset activity, perpetual futures trades, and upcoming private transactions. Lower transaction costs could support more on-chain trading and network use, benefiting INJ's core use case. Predictable fees also give users a clearer view of transaction costs before they submit activity to the network.
The chain upgrade to bring the lowest predictable gas fees on Injective is now live.
Injective already has some of the lowest gas fees. Now RWAs, perp trades and soon private transactions will all run on the lowest fixed gas fees.
Built for every user, trader and institution.

title: Injective: IIP-709 gas fee upgrade goes live - 17 Oct 2026
